comment: The section suggests that using ArchiMate makes the architecture authorable, checkable, and comparable. ArchiMate provides a structured modelling language, but it does not automatically guarantee semantic consistency, model quality, completeness, or conformance.

anchor.note: p.42 l.Lines 34-46 read as the printed page; section 3.1 agrees

public.text: The section suggests that using ArchiMate makes the architecture authorable, checkable, and comparable. ArchiMate provides a structured modelling language, but it does not automatically guarantee semantic consistency, model quality, completeness, or conformance.
public.suggestedRevision: Qualify the claim by stating that ArchiMate enables automated and manual checking when supported by agreed modelling conventions, identifiers, validation rules, governance, and quality-assurance processes.
